Gegründet im Jahr 1981 durch **Erwin Mün:
Founded in 1981 by **Erwin Münten**, the group began with ten guitar enthusiasts from Schwalmtal whom he taught in his spare time.

The number of guitar enthusiasts grew steadily over the years. In 1993, Erwin Münten turned his hobby into a profession and led Schwalmtalzupfer together with his son **Benjamin Münten** until 2022. Benjamin Münten took over sole leadership in 2023.

For Erwin and Benny, Schwalmtalzupfer has always been more than a profession. Through the youth development association registered in 1996 (**Jugendförderung Schwalmtal-Zupfer e.V.**), it also serves as a charitable organisation for children and young people. The children go on an annual trip to a pony farm, while the teenagers take a youth trip every two years.

Alongside these leisure activities, Schwalmtalzupfer organises two major concerts each year. The summer concert is usually an open-air event with all players on stage together. Shortly before Christmas, the group gathers for three days of concerts over an Advent weekend at the **Achim-Besgen-Halle**. Smaller groups also perform at several events between the major concerts.

With more than 300 guitarists, Schwalmtalzupfer ranks as the largest and most enduring **guitar orchestra in Europe**.
Liebe Mitspieler, Freunde und Interessen:
Dear fellow musicians, friends and everyone interested in joining us,

We see ourselves as a group brought together by the joy of playing the guitar and singing. The ongoing interest in our shared work — which we hope will continue — demonstrates the importance of social connections across generations, both in music and in leisure activities.

This approach leads not only to major projects such as CDs and winter concerts, but also to performances by smaller groups, charity events and leisure activities for the children and young people of Schwalmtalzupfer.

We hope that the joy we experience in making music together will continue to reach others in the future.

For us, classical guitar technique and perfection are not the primary goal. Alongside the enjoyment of playing and singing, we aim — from a social and educational perspective — to support each person's growth and development through caring relationships within a supportive community.

Wir, die **Jugendförderung Schwalmtalzup:
We, **Jugendförderung Schwalmtalzupfer e.V.**, nurture the musical talents of children, young people and adults in the Schwalmtal region. We believe making music is important for development at every age, and support this through a variety of activities.

Every year we organise a **summer concert**, with around 300 musicians sharing a stage to entertain the audience. At our **winter concerts** in the Achim-Besgen-Halle in Waldniel, our guitars, accompanied by the band and choir, help the audience get into the Christmas spirit. We build a sense of community among children, young people and adults by making music on stage and taking trips together.
